description: No Lua 5.1 binary chunk serializer deserializer loader or verifier; source Proto execution only
No stable Lua C API ABI headers lauxlib or external C consumer contract
No package.loadlib dynamic library loading symbol lookup or native module lifecycle
getfenv setfenv load reader functions and per-function environments are not implemented

Existing format s d i f q percent and find plain init byte classes escapes greedy star plus ordinary nested empty-string and position captures have bounded contracts; backreferences balanced frontier optional and non-greedy quantifiers gmatch gsub other formats string.dump locale printf floating edges nonfinite values integers outside signed i32 and matcher resource limits remain unavailable or partial
io input output lines tmpfile popen setvbuf and complete text-mode number parsing are not all implemented
locale local timezone DST CPU clock os.exit and platform-specific status tuples are approximated or unavailable
package.loaders cpath module and seeall are unavailable; Lua path preload loaded and require are implemented
local variable APIs hooks function environments and every getinfo field are unavailable
math.random does not reproduce the host C rand sequence and GC tuning/count units are teaching-runtime contracts
Windows OsString argv and paths use a documented lossy UTF-8 adapter
The 39-op teaching ISA semantically maps all official 38 opcodes but is not their binary encoding
